about.title: About Zina
about.lead: Zina Al Mokri reviews the world's finest beauty with one rule: she only recommends what she would buy again with her own money.

sections.title: How she reviews
sections.body: Every product is worn for at least two weeks, in daylight, under make-up and on bare skin. Notes are taken on day one, day seven and day fourteen, and only then does a verdict reach Instagram or this site.

sections.title: No paid verdicts
sections.body: Houses send their newest work, but no review is ever paid for and no house sees a review before it is published. If something does not work, she says so, kindly and clearly.

sections.title: Why a shop
sections.body: Followers kept asking where to find what she recommends, in their country and with honest shipping. The shop exists for that: a short list, confirmed shipping, and a person at the other end of every order.

shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.lead: We ship worldwide. Because rates and customs differ by country, our team confirms your shipping fee personally before anything is charged.

sections.title: How shipping is calculated
sections.body: After you place an order, we check the best carrier for your address and confirm the shipping fee and the final total by email (and on WhatsApp if you chose it). You only pay once you have seen the final total.

sections.title: Delivery times
sections.body: Most orders leave within two working days of confirmation. Delivery usually takes 2 to 5 working days in the GCC and 4 to 10 working days elsewhere.

sections.title: Customs and duties
sections.body: Some countries charge import duties or taxes on arrival. We tell you when we confirm your order if this is likely for your country.

sections.title: Tracking
sections.body: When your order ships you receive the carrier and tracking number by email, and you can follow it on your private order page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains what personal data we collect when you order, why, and how long we keep it.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, email, phone and WhatsApp number, shipping address and order details. We do not store card numbers: card payments happen with our payment partner.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To process and deliver your order, to contact you about it, and to meet our legal and accounting obligations. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body: Only the carrier delivering your order, our payment partner for card payments, and the email provider that sends our order emails.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: Order records are kept for as long as the law requires for accounting, then deleted.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask for a copy of your data, for corrections, or for deletion where the law allows. Write to us and we will reply within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.lead: These terms apply to orders placed on this site.

sections.title: Orders
sections.body: Placing an order is a request to buy. A contract is formed when we confirm your order and its final total, including shipping.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body: Prices are shown in the listed currency and cover the product only. Shipping is confirmed separately before payment.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: You can pay cash on delivery, by card through a secure payment link, or arrange payment with our team on WhatsApp.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: For hygiene reasons, opened beauty products cannot be returned. Unopened products can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

sections.title: Reviews
sections.body: Reviews reflect Zina's personal experience. Results vary from person to person.
